records.speaker: Captain chooser
records.context: Four alternative introductory biographies. The DS chooser displays the registered four ARM9 texts.
records.source_meaning: A Portuguese boy drawn to sailing goes to sea at a friend’s urging. The route is recommended to new players.
records.localization_note: Use the corresponding approved chooser biography and its established names.
records.Japanese:
船乗りに漠然と憧れる
ポルトガルの少年。
友人にそそのかされて
海に出ることになる。
初めてプレイする方に
おすすめ。
records.previous_English: Admiral, people are gathering in the square.
records.english: A Portuguese boy dreams of the sea. A friend talks him into setting sail. Great for first-time players.

records.speaker: Captain chooser
records.context: Four alternative introductory biographies. The DS chooser displays the registered four ARM9 texts.
records.source_meaning: After Sweden regains independence, its admiral leads a privateer fleet and wants it to become the strongest in the world.
records.localization_note: Use the corresponding approved chooser biography and its established names.
records.Japanese:
再独立を果たした
スウェーデンの提督。
海軍とは名ばかりの
私掠艦隊を率いる。
自国の艦隊を世界最強
にすべく活動する。
records.previous_English: Admiral, people are gathering in the square.
records.english: Sweden is free again. Its admiral leads a navy in name only and aims to make his privateers second to none.

records.speaker: Captain chooser
records.context: Four alternative introductory biographies. The DS chooser displays the registered four ARM9 texts.
records.source_meaning: A business-minded Dutch girl and Camille, her childhood friend and partner, set sail to make their fortune.
records.localization_note: Use the corresponding approved chooser biography and its established names.
records.Japanese:
商魂たくましい
オランダの少女。
幼なじみの相棒カミル
とともに、
一旗揚げようと
世界の海に飛び出す。
records.previous_English: Admiral, people are gathering in the square.
records.english: A Dutch girl sails the world to make her name in trade with Camille, her childhood friend and partner.

records.speaker: Captain chooser
records.context: Four alternative introductory biographies. The DS chooser displays the registered four ARM9 texts.
records.source_meaning: A woman admiral of Ming leads her private fleet against wokou raids in defiance of the country’s isolation law.
records.localization_note: Use the corresponding approved chooser biography and its established names.
records.Japanese:
倭寇に苦しめられる
人々を守るために
国法である鎖国政策を
あえて無視し、
私設艦隊を率いて戦う
明（みん）の女提督。
records.previous_English: The game cannot save here. Start anyway?
records.english: Defying the isolation law, a Ming admiral leads her own fleet to protect people from wokou raids.
